name: Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development Co.,Ltd engages in the development and construction, investment promotion, industrial development, and carrier operation management in China. Its property portfolio comprises industrial spaces, commercial offices, research centers, residential and commercial real estates, and apartments. Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development Co.,Ltd was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
